## Invitations

A total of 1808 people were invited during the outreach activity. Of these, 1287 attended, giving an attendance rate of 71.2 per cent. The figures indicate that participation remained substantial in relation to the number of invitations issued. Attendance information has been recorded for review alongside the invitation activity and follow-up arrangements.

Van days were retained where road conditions allowed access. This helped maintain the planned outreach approach while recognising local travel constraints. The arrangements supported continued contact with invited people and provided an established basis for attendance monitoring.

## Contact

SMS contact was used to reach 1556 invitees. Reminders were also sent to 1556 people. The matching totals show that reminder activity was aligned with the SMS contact list. These communications formed the main follow-up process for those invited and were recorded as part of the outreach activity.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
